items.heading: Answer a Few Questions
items.text: Answer a few questions and the finder ranks the routes in this chart for you, shows how many doors each keeps open, what each costs in exam pressure and money, and gives you a 30-day experiment for your top two. Choose student if you are choosing for yourself, or parent if you are helping your child.

items.heading: The Career Chart After 10th
items.text: The career chart after 10th PDF download is free, opens straight away and needs no sign-up. Print it, put it on the wall and use a pen on it. The all-routes file carries a one-page plan to fill in.

items.heading: Start At the Top Question
items.text: Start at the top question and follow the answers down. Each coloured end point is a route. Tap it to jump to that route's full card further down the page.

items.heading: Which Subject Groups Does
items.text: Which subject groups does the school actually offer? Not every school runs PCMB, commerce with Maths or a given arts combination, and many set their own minimum marks.

items.heading: How Is the Diploma
items.text: How is the diploma or ITI seat filled? Usually through the state technical education board or the state skill department, by merit or a test. Dates and cut-offs differ every year.

items.heading: Is the Institute Approved,
items.text: Is the institute approved, and what is the total fee? Ask for the approval proof and the full fee list before paying anything.

items.heading: What Did Last Year's Students
items.text: What did last year's students do next? Ask for the number who found work, joined apprenticeship training or took lateral entry.
